name: Lluwen
description: Lluwen is a hoofed elf hunter from Lorwyn who turned against Morcant, followed the students to Arcavios, and became a Witherbloom student at Strixhaven.

summary.text: Lluwen is a hoofed elf hunter from Lorwyn who turned against Morcant, followed the students to Arcavios, and became a Witherbloom student at Strixhaven.

bio.text: Serving High Perfect Morcant, Lluwen captured the student Kirol in the Gilt-Leaf Wood and brought them to Lys Alana.
Horrified by Morcant's plans to kill the night with dawnglow, he refused to let Kirol die, abandoned Morcant, and later headbutted her and stole her vial.
Fearing that Morcant would kill him, he asked to come along, and Ajani brought him through an Omenpath to Arcavios.
At Strixhaven he was admitted to Witherbloom, befriended Tam, cut Ivarin after being taunted, and found archaics gathered around a snarl in a hollow titan.
He led the group out of the chamber behind the lumarets, then spotted Jadzi's incomplete chain spell and, with the lumarets mirroring him, helped calm the archaic.

status.text: As of the latest story Lluwen is a Strixhaven student whom Tam found at the Folioplex and sent home with his friends.

timeline.summary: Lluwen holds a knife to Kirol and demands to know what they know about why Isilu walks.
timeline.quote: I know you know why Isilu walks. I want to know what you know.

timeline.summary: Lluwen takes Kirol prisoner to bring before High Perfect Morcant, and leads them deeper into the forest.
timeline.quote: High Perfect Morcant will want to see you.

timeline.summary: Lluwen marches Kirol through the forest while they argue about hiking shoes and hooves.
timeline.quote: That's because you don't have feet,

timeline.summary: Lluwen brings Kirol to Lys Alana, a gilded city of boardwalks and towers.
timeline.quote: Come along. I'm taking you to High Perfect Morcant now.

timeline.summary: Lluwen presents Kirol to Morcant, claiming they know something of why Isilu walks out of sync.
timeline.quote: I've found a stranger in the forest who knows something of Isilu and why he walks out of sync with his promised time.

timeline.summary: Morcant muses about killing the night with dawnglow mixed with summer dreams, horrifying Lluwen.
timeline.quote: With the weapons of the night, of course.

timeline.summary: Morcant and Lluwen force Kirol, bound, toward a grove claimed by Isilu to gather dawnglove.
timeline.quote: You're going to go inside and gather them for us.

timeline.summary: Morcant orders Kirol back for more dawnglove; Kirol and Lluwen refuse.
timeline.quote: They don't deserve to die that way.

timeline.summary: Lluwen decides to follow Kirol and Ajani, abandoning Morcant.
timeline.quote: Lluwen had an instant to make up his mind.

timeline.summary: Lluwen headbutts Morcant, steals her vial and throws it to Sanar.
timeline.quote: He leaned over to pluck the vial from her hand.

timeline.summary: Morcant transforms to her Shadowmoor self and bows apologetically to Isilu as the students flee with Lluwen to reach Maralen.
timeline.quote: We're going to see the queen,

timeline.summary: Eirdu's belling cry halts the battle as Eirdu arrives and Oko drops from the air.
timeline.quote: A golden glow appeared on the horizon, growing brighter and brighter before rising like the sun, and Eirdu appeared.

timeline.summary: Kirol, Sanar and Lluwen race back with the vial of dawnglow rather than greet Eirdu.
timeline.quote: We can do both,

timeline.summary: Oko takes the vial of dawnglow from Kirol and flies off with it.
timeline.quote: Oko barely seemed to move as he snatched it away.

timeline.summary: Lluwen slips away to follow Ajani and the students, fearing Morcant, and asks to come along.
timeline.quote: But I helped one of the students, and if I stay here, they will kill me.

timeline.summary: Ajani leads the group through an Omenpath to Shandalar and on to Arcavios, bringing Lluwen.
timeline.quote: Together, they walked into the cascading light, and another world was left behind.

timeline.summary: Lluwen writes about feeling isolated among Arcavian elves and plans to join the Witherbloom trip to Titan's Grave.
timeline.quote: There's a Witherbloom trip to Titan's Grave in the works right now.

timeline.summary: Tam recounts meeting Fel at night and decides he is worth working with; she offers to accompany Lluwen.
timeline.quote: Lluwen, if it would help you to have company, I don't mind coming along at all.

timeline.summary: Lluwen describes his admission interview with Fel, who stamps his form anyway.
timeline.quote: But he stamped my form anyway.

timeline.summary: Lluwen and Tam arrive at Jawdocks Landing in Titan's Grave, where Jadzi and Fel greet the students.
timeline.quote: Oracle Jadzi was the one who greeted all of us when we arrived at Jawdocks Landing.

timeline.summary: Tam and Lluwen talk for hours with Jadzi until Fel scolds them for wasting the oracle's time.
timeline.quote: We spent a few hours talking, just the three of us

timeline.summary: Lluwen discovers a society of lumarets with a map in Toadstool Copse.
timeline.quote: The creature had friends.

timeline.summary: Fel dismisses Lluwen's discovery of the lumarets as not worth studying and threatens community service.
timeline.quote: They aren't in any of the records because they aren't worth studying,

timeline.summary: Tam consoles Lluwen and tells him of a frightening encounter with the same spirit, who threw a spear at her group.
timeline.quote: He hurled a spectral spear at me.

timeline.summary: Fel quizzes his students on what they hear; Lluwen, stung by yesterday's rebuke, wants to give a right answer.
timeline.quote: I want to give the right answer

timeline.summary: Ivarin taunts Lluwen as a goat and ram-clan, and Lluwen retaliates by slashing his chest with a knife.
timeline.quote: He dragged the knife across Ivarin's chest.

timeline.summary: Fel pins Lluwen's coat to a tree with a thorn and orders him to control himself or find another home.
timeline.quote: You will learn to control yourself, or you will learn to find another home,

timeline.summary: Lluwen realizes the titan's bones are hollow and falls through into the dark.
timeline.quote: Lluwen fell into the dark.

timeline.summary: Lluwen wakes in the titan's hollow to find six archaics gathered around a snarl of magic and chanting.
timeline.quote: six enormous figures, each with too many limbs undulating in time, sat gathered around a thick snarl of magic—archaics.

timeline.summary: The archaics notice Lluwen sketching and stop, and he flees up a vine while their chant grows louder.
timeline.quote: Lluwen didn't need to be told twice.

timeline.summary: Fel hauls Lluwen out and asks if he has anything to impress him; Lluwen is too afraid to tell him what he saw.
timeline.quote: I hope you have something to impress me.

timeline.summary: Tam tells Lluwen that archaics were once oracles and suggests speaking with Jadzi.
timeline.quote: she told me that all archaics used to be oracles.

timeline.summary: Lluwen overhears Fel and Jadzi argue over Fel's scheme involving students and an oath he swore.
timeline.quote: No, I swore an oath of devotion, Jadzi.

timeline.summary: Lluwen decides not to tell Fel about the archaics and returns to his room.
timeline.quote: No. He couldn't tell Fel.

timeline.summary: Lluwen admits to Tam that he did not tell Jadzi about the archaics; Tam hugs him.
timeline.quote: You aren't a coward.

timeline.summary: The ground shakes and a massive creature wreathed in star arches looms over the camp, and Tam freezes.
timeline.quote: A massive figure blocked the gold of the moon.

timeline.summary: The giant creature stands and walks away, leaving the camp in chaos.
timeline.quote: it walked away.

timeline.summary: Fel asks Tam and Lluwen if they have seen Oracle Jadzi, who is missing.
timeline.quote: His eyes burning, Fel asked the two of them if they had seen Oracle Jadzi.

timeline.summary: Chandra says she must make sure Ajani has not been compromised, and Lluwen reveals the masked figures are Oriq.
timeline.quote: They're the Oriq.

timeline.summary: Ajani tackles Chandra as she prepares to blast the archaic, and Lluwen spots Jadzi in its palm.
timeline.quote: Ajani bowled her over and took them both to the ground.

timeline.summary: Lluwen tells Tam they are in Titan's Grave, deeper than any records go.
timeline.quote: "In Titan's Grave. Deeper than we have any records of going, if we can trust the Shattered."

timeline.summary: Lluwen volunteers to scout a path out, and Suki insists he take someone with him; Kirol claims the job.
timeline.quote: "It's best if you have someone with you.

timeline.summary: Lluwen is moved that Kirol would talk to their family for him; Kirol is stung when Lluwen changes the subject.
timeline.quote: "Well, yeah. But I would for you."

timeline.summary: Lluwen finds the lumarets and believes they will lead the way out.
timeline.quote: "I think I found our way out of here."

timeline.summary: Lluwen leads the group through the tunnels behind the lumarets, growing proud.
timeline.quote: The young elf strode proud down the twisting, impossible hallways.

timeline.summary: A strange feeling of dread spreads through the group and tempers flare; Lluwen snaps at Tam and Kirol.
timeline.quote: "You're the one who brought up the tension.

timeline.summary: The tunnel turns against the students and roots seize Lluwen, threatening to drag him into the earth while his friends pull him back.
timeline.quote: Vines wrapped around Lluwen's ankles and threatened to pull him into the earth.

timeline.summary: Kirol promises not to leave Lluwen behind.
timeline.quote: "I'm not going to leave you behind, Lulu!"

timeline.summary: Lluwen asks Fel whether he made a deal with the daemogoth, and Fel dismisses it.
timeline.quote: "With that provincial bogeyman? Ridiculous. It has nothing to offer me."

timeline.summary: Lluwen tells Fel he saw archaics gathered around a snarl, and Fel says there are no snarls in Titan's Grave and asks to be taken there.
timeline.quote: "There are no snarls in Titan's Grave. There never have been,"

timeline.summary: Tam leads the group's friends into the caverns, and Sanar smells burning.
timeline.quote: "Does anyone else smell burning?"

timeline.summary: The students feel reality tremble as they run toward the fight.
timeline.quote: Reality was a rippling tapestry being torn apart and rewoven right before their eyes.

timeline.summary: The group is thrown through shifting environments as reality ripples around the archaic.
timeline.quote: Kirol spit up sea water.

timeline.summary: Tam tells her friends that she was made to do this and that they made her happy, then steps into the pit.
timeline.quote: "I was made to do this."

timeline.summary: The nexus snaps shut after Tam jumps in, leaving the friends shocked.
timeline.quote: Lluwen stared at the not-snarl as it snapped shut.

timeline.summary: Reality destabilizes and the air starts to fail; Suki is brought low.
timeline.quote: Reality wasn't stable around this panicking god-like being.

timeline.summary: Lluwen spots Jadzi's incomplete chain spell on the archaic and urges everyone to finish it.
timeline.quote: "Everyone! We have to finish the spell!"

timeline.summary: Lluwen's plea reaches Kirol, who throws Fel aside and rallies everyone to follow Lluwen.
timeline.quote: "All right!" they said. "Let's go! Everybody follow Lluwen!"

timeline.summary: Lluwen speaks to the archaic, and the lumarets mirror his movements, lending power to the spell.
timeline.quote: They were mirroring him.

timeline.summary: Gold light of unity encases the archaic and settles reality; Chandra and Ajani move again.
timeline.quote: They were encasing it.

timeline.summary: Fel, freed from the amber, credits Lluwen for soothing the archaic.
timeline.quote: young Lluwen has found a way to soothe it."

timeline.summary: Lluwen betrays his superiors in Lorwyn to help Strixhaven students and then joins them as a student.
timeline.quote: Most recently, he betrayed his superiors in Lorwyn to help a group of Strixhaven students

timeline.summary: Tam sees a vision of Lluwen telling her she is just parts.
timeline.quote: "You're just parts ."

timeline.summary: Tam passes Chandra in the tower and sees Lluwen's vision resentfully remark about half people.
timeline.quote: Why do these half people get to win when the real ones have to die?"

timeline.summary: Tam finds Kirol, Sanar, Abigale and Lluwen at the Folioplex and apologizes for what happened to Jadzi and to them.
timeline.quote: What happened to Jadzi is my responsibility.

timeline.summary: Tam directs her friends to the mage-ring and sends them home to Strixhaven.
timeline.quote: "Mage-ring at the back of the Folioplex," she replies

relations.note: Tam accompanies Lluwen to Titan's Grave.
relations.quote: if it would help you to have company, I don't mind coming along at all.

relations.note: Fel is Lluwen's Witherbloom professor and dismisses his finding.
relations.quote: Either keep surveying and return with something useful
If you ever want to talk about it, I'm here.

relations.note: Fel is Lluwen's professor and disciplines him.
relations.quote: Call for a healer. Ivarin will need care.

relations.note: She shares his tent to keep him company and hugs him.
relations.quote: But Tam had wanted to keep her friend company

relations.note: Kirol calls themself Lluwen's chum and refuses to leave him behind.
Lluwen calls Kirol his best friend.
relations.quote: "Who are you, and what have you done with my best friend?"

pages_say.description: A hoofed elf hunter in green and brown who captures Kirol and says he is a poor hunter.
A hooved elf hunter of the Nightshade pack who captures Kirol and takes them to Lys Alana.
An elf hunter who refuses to send Kirol back to die and defects with Ajani and Kirol.
An elf hunter who turns on Morcant, steals her vial and flees with the students.
An elf hunter who turned against Morcant and joins the students on Arcavios.
An elf who prefers animals to people, born to elvish supremacists.
An elf from Lorwyn who joins Strixhaven's Witherbloom college and struggles to fit in.
A Lorwyn elf hunter and Witherbloom student who stabs a classmate, finds archaics in a hollow titan and overhears Fel and Jadzi.
A Lorwyn elf student whose green smoke signal brings the others and who names the Shattered as the Oriq.
A young elf student and former scout from Lorwyn who leads the group out of the chamber, but grows prideful and is seized by a daemogoth.
A student who, with others, feared the worst for Jadzi.
A young Lorwyn elf student who, with the lumarets' help, finishes Jadzi's spell and calms the archaic.
An elf from Lorwyn who betrayed his superiors to help Strixhaven students and then joined them as a student.
A friend of Tam who appears in a vision saying she is just parts.
A friend who appears to Tam in visions, bitter that half-people win while real ones die.
A Strixhaven student who refuses to join the hug.
